note: Neither jobId nor allFailed. The oneOf makes the discriminator mandatory — an empty payload must not be readable as 'retry everything'.
Both jobId and allFailed. Ambiguous intent: a consumer would have to choose between one job and all of them, so the schema refuses rather than letting each implementation pick.
allFailed: false. The const pins it to true so the member means 'do the bulk operation' and never 'do something else'; a false here is a client that meant to send jobId.
Empty jobId. minLength 1 stops a dropped identifier arriving as a well-formed request naming nothing.
Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false catches `force`, which a caller might assume exists by analogy with other queue operations.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
